column1: # Rule-checkable cases (chess, ōgi, xiongqi, and mixed pairings), serving both
# as minimal golden vectors and as a seed for the harness. Replace or augment
# with vectors produced by a reference implementation (Ruby, Elixir, …) for a
# Illegal move (no piece on a1): position unchanged.
# Uchifuzume (ōgi): dropping a Fu that mates is illegal.
# Fu drop giving a plain check (ōgi): allowed, game ongoing.
# Xiongqi quiet move (Chariot a1->a4): game ongoing.
# Mixed pairing (ōgi vs xiongqi), quiet move (ōgi Rook a1->a4): game ongoing. Self-consistency only (computed by this engine, not an external reference implementation).
# Mixed pairing (xiongqi vs chess), back-rank mate (Chariot a1->a8) against a chess King: checkmate. Self-consistency only, same caveat as above.
